title: The Quiet Bridge
author: Felix Yarrow
blurb: Cyrus Reyes, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
